camera

System camera. QR code scanning function is supported. Related API: ma.createCameraContext

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description Remarks
device-position String back No Camera direction.
resolution String medium No Resolution. Dynamic modification is not supported. Not supported in Android.
flash String auto No Flash. The options are as follows: auto, on, and off.
bindstop eventHandle No Triggered when the camera stops abnormally, for example, when the camera exits the backend.
binderror eventHandle No Triggered when a camera is not allowed to use.
bindinitdone Eventhandle No Triggered when the camera initialization is complete. e.detail = {maxZoom}
bindrecorderror Eventhandle No This event is triggered when a recording exits abnormally. The error information and the storage path of the stopped recording are returned.
desc String No Purpose information. This parameter will be displayed in the permission popup.（Added in 26.6.0-LG0001）

Valid Values of resolution

Value Description Remarks
low Low. Not supported in Android.
medium Medium. Not supported in Android.
high High. Not supported in Android.

Valid Values of device-position

Valid Value Description
front Front.
back Back.

Valid Values of flash

Valid Value Description Remarks
auto Automatic.
on On.
off Off.
torch Torch. Not supported in Android.

bindrecorderror Callback Function

Parameters

Object res

Attribute Type Description
errMsg String Error message indicating that recording stops abnormally.
tempVideoPath String Path for storing abnormally stopped recordings.
tempThumbPath String Path for storing the cover of the recording that stops abnormally.

Sample Code

1. Camera Viewfinder with Device Position & Flash

<view class="camera-wrapper">
  <camera device-position="back" flash="off" style="width: 100%; height: 220px; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;">
    <cover-view style="position: absolute; bottom: 10px; left: 10px; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); color: #fff; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px;">
      Device: Back | Flash: Off
    </cover-view>
  </camera>
</view>
Page({ data: {} });
.camera-wrapper { width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }

Bug & Tip

  1. Only one camera component can be inserted into a page.
  2. Pay attention to the usage restrictions of native components.
